```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(Seurat)
library(speckle)
library(limma)
library(ggrepel)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(introdataviz)
library(CellChat)

lacols<-c("LA+"="#8DB600","LA-"="#5E4FA2",none="white")


sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"&
              !sc$harmonized_major_cell_type%in%c("Exclude","Erythrocytes","Exhausted CD8 T-cells")))
gc()
sc$has_LA<-ifelse(sc$LA_per_Sample>0,"LA+","LA-")
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_remove(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type," \\(.+"))%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_replace(nosub,"Memmo","Memo"))
aux_table<-sc@meta.data


```

```{r}
aux_table<-aux_table%>%filter(str_detect(nosub,"B|T-|NK|Macr|Plas|Dend|Mas"))
props<-getTransformedProps(aux_table$nosub,
                           aux_table$SampleName)
temp<-aux_table%>%distinct(has_LA,SampleName)
designM<-model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=temp)#groups around 
colnames(designM)<-c("LAn","LAy")

props<-props$TransformedProps[,temp$SampleName]
fit<-lmFit(props,designM)
cont<-makeContrasts(LAy-LAn,levels = designM)
fit<-contrasts.fit(fit,cont)
fit <- eBayes(fit, robust=TRUE)
res<-topTable(fit,number = nrow(props),coef = 1)
```

# Differential expression
```{r}
bulk<-AggregateExpression(
  sc,
  assays = "RNA",
  return.seurat = T,
  group.by = c("SampleName","nosub","has_LA"))

#i<-bulk@meta.data%>%count(nosub)%>%
#  filter(n>10)%>%distinct(nosub)%>%
#  unlist()
#all subsets include >100 cells from >10 samples
bulk<-lapply(unique(sc$nosub), function(x) 
  subset(bulk,subset =nosub==x ))
names(bulk)<-unique(sc$nosub)
deg<-lapply(bulk,function(x) 
  FindMarkers(x,group.by="has_LA",ident.1="LA+",
              ident.2="LA-",test.use="MAST",logfc.threshold=0))
deg<-lapply(names(deg),function(x) 
  deg[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
#write_csv(deg,"docs/has_laDEG-nosub_bulk-MAST.tsv")

ranks<-split(deg,f = deg$ct)%>%lapply(function(x) 
  x%>%add_count(gene)%>%filter(n==1)%>%arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))%>%
    distinct(gene,avg_log2FC)%>%deframe)

gsea_bp<-lapply(ranks,function(x) 
  gseGO(x,OrgDb = 'org.Hs.eg.db',seed = T,
        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,minGSSize = 50,
        ont = "BP",keyType = "SYMBOL"))
gsea_bp<-lapply(gsea_bp,simplify)

gsea_bp<-lapply(names(gsea_bp),function(x)
  gsea_bp[[x]]%>%as.data.frame()%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
#gsea_bp%>%write_csv("docs/has_laDEG-nosubbulk-GSEA-BPsimpl.csv")

```

## top genes
```{r}
i<-gsea_bp%>%separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%distinct(ct,core_enrichment)
colnames(i)[2]<-"gene"
subdeg<-deg%>%inner_join(i)

avgLAneg<-AverageExpression(subset(sc,subset = has_LA=="LA+"),
                            group.by = "nosub",assays = "SCT")
avgLAneg<-as.data.frame(avgLAneg$SCT)%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "ct",values_to = "LA-")
avgLApos<-AverageExpression(subset(sc,subset = has_LA=="LA+"),
                            group.by = "nosub",assays = "SCT")
avgLApos<-as.data.frame(avgLApos)%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "ct",values_to = "LA+")
avgs<-avgLAneg%>%inner_join(avgLApos)
write_csv(avgs,"docs/hasLA_nosub_avg.csv")

subdeg<-avgs%>%group_by(ct)%>%
  filter(`LA-`>quantile(`LA-`,.95)|`LA+`>quantile(`LA+`,.95))%>%#0.5 for Th2 cells
  inner_join(subdeg)
subdeg<-subdeg%>%slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC),n=15)
subdeg<-gsea_bp%>%separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
  mutate(gene=core_enrichment)%>%select(Description,NES,gene,ct)%>%
  right_join(subdeg,by=c("ct","gene"))

subdeg<-subdeg%>%mutate(diff=`LA+`-`LA-`)%>%
  filter((avg_log2FC>0&diff>0&NES>0)|(avg_log2FC<0&diff<0&NES<0))%>%
  select(-c(p_val,pct.1,pct.2,NES))%>%group_by(ct,gene)%>%
  mutate(Description=paste(sort(unique(Description)),collapse = ','))%>%distinct()
```

```{r}
temp<-gsea_bp%>%filter(ct=="B-cells")
#i<-c("LRRK2","IL6","STAP1","ITGAM","CCL3")

  filter(core_enrichment%in%i)%>%
  select(-core_enrichment)%>%distinct()%>%
  mutate(status=ifelse(NES>0,"LA+","LA-"))%>%
  group_by(status)%>%slice_max(abs(NES),n=5)%>%

pD<-gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%j&ct=="B-cells")%>%
    mutate(Description=str_replace(Description,"endoplasmic reticulum","ER")%>%
```

# cell chat
```{r}
cc_res<-readRDS("docs/CellChat_nosubPE_hasLA.rds")

cts<-rownames(cc_res[[1]]@net$LApos$count)
pE<-netVisual_diffInteraction(cc_res[[1]],color.use = alt_cellcols,
                              measure = "count",
                              targets.use = "B-cells",
                              sources.use = cts[str_detect(cts,"Smo|En|Mes|Ery",negate=T)],
                              remove.isolate = T)


temp<-subsetCommunication(cc_res$LApos)
temp<-temp%>%filter(target=="B-cells"&str_detect(source,"M1|Ear|Eff|Den|Th17"))
i<-temp%>%separate_rows(receptor,sep = "_")%>%distinct(receptor,target)
colnames(i)<-c("gene","ct")
i<-temp%>%separate_rows(ligand,sep = "_")%>%
  mutate(gene=ligand,ct=source)%>%
  distinct(gene,ct)%>%bind_rows(i)

i<-i%>%inner_join(avgs)%>%mutate(diffe=`LA+`-`LA-`)
i<-i%>%filter(avg_log2FC>0&diffe>0&avg_log2FC>.5)

pF<-deg%>%filter(str_detect(ct,"M1|Ear|Eff|Den|Th17|B")&
                   gene%in%c("MIF","LGALS9","CD40LG","CD74","CD44","CD40"))%>%
  mutate(LR=ifelse(gene%in%c("CD74","CD44","CD40"),"receptor","ligand"))%>%
  filter((ct=="B-cells"&LR=="receptor")|ct!="B-cells"&LR=="ligand")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=gene,y=ct,col=avg_log2FC))+geom_point(size=3)+
  facet_wrap(~LR,scales="free",nrow=2,space="free_y")+
  scale_color_gradient2(low="blue",mid="white",high = "red")+
  theme_bw()+labs(col="LFC",x="",y="")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank())
```

```{r}

  scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
  theme_bw()+theme(strip.background = element_blank())+
  labs(x="",y="",col="Scaled expression",size="%")

#pG2=NOS in CosMx(spatial plot)<-----------------------------------------------------------

files<-list.files()
files<-files[str_detect(files,"bg")][-1]#no endometrioma
metadata<-lapply(files,vroom::vroom)%>%bind_rows()
gc()
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(fov_type=="CD8 T cells")
mat<-vroom::vroom("endometrium.csv")%>%filter(cell_ID%in%metadata$cell_ID)
mat<-vroom::vroom("PE.csv")%>%filter(cell_ID%in%metadata$cell_ID)%>%bind_rows(mat)
gc()    

mat<-mat%>%column_to_rownames("cell_ID")%>%t()
negavg<-colMeans(mat[c("Ms IgG1","Rb IgG"),])
normi<-t(t(mat)-negavg)
normi<-asinh(normi/5)
nobatch<-sva::ComBat(dat = normi,batch = str_remove(colnames(normi),"c_1.+"),
                     BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 2))

#PD-1 is elevated in index 2
temp<-metadata%>%select(cell_ID,dom_nEndoh1_75,Class,fov_type)
temp<-nobatch%>%t()%>%as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_ID")%>%select(cell_ID,iNOS)%>%
  inner_join(temp)
temp<-temp%>%mutate(index=case_when(dom_nEndoh1_75==6~1,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==3~2,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==4~3,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==2~4,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==1~6,
                                    TRUE~dom_nEndoh1_75))#as defined in Fig2
pG2<-temp%>%mutate(Run_Tissue_name=str_remove(cell_ID,"c_.+"))%>%
  group_by(Run_Tissue_name,index)%>%summarise(iNOS=mean(iNOS))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=as.factor(index),y=iNOS,col=as.factor(index)))+
  geom_violin()+geom_jitter(width = .1)+
  labs(x="Domain",y="Average iNOS")+theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",ref.group = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=domcol)+theme(legend.position = "n")
```

# Metabolism
```{r}
library(limma)
library(scMetabolism)

sc<-sc.metabolism.Seurat(obj = sc, method = "VISION",
                         imputation = F, ncores = 6, metabolism.type = "KEGG")
#metabo<-sc@
metabo%>%write_csv("docs/scMetabolism_res.csv")

signatures_KEGG_metab <- system.file("data", "KEGG_metabolism_nc.gmt", 
                                     package = "scMetabolism")
signatures_KEGG_metab <- BaseSet::getGMT(signatures_KEGG_metab)
signatureSize<-signatures_KEGG_metab%>%as.data.frame()%>%count(sets)
metabo<-metabo[signatureSize$sets,]

aux_table<-aux_table%>%rownames_to_column("Cell")
meta<-aux_table%>%mutate(has_LA=ifelse(has_LA=="LA+","T","F"))
meta<-meta%>%split(f = meta$nosub)
metabo<-lapply(meta,function(x) metabo[,x$Cell])
designM<-lapply(meta,function(x) model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=x))
cont<-lapply(designM,function(x) 
  makeContrasts(has_LAT-has_LAF,levels = x))
fit<-lapply(names(meta),function(x) lmFit(log(metabo[[x]]),designM[[x]]))
names(fit)<-names(meta)
fit<-lapply(names(fit),function(x) contrasts.fit(fit[[x]],cont[[x]]))
fit <- lapply(fit,eBayes,robust=TRUE,trend=sqrt(signatureSize$n))
names(fit)<-names(meta)
res<-lapply(fit,topTable,number = 85,coef = 1)
res<-lapply(names(res),function(x) 
  res[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("pathway")%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()

i<-res%>%filter(str_detect(ct,"En|Mes|Sm",negate = T))%>%
  group_by(pathway)%>%summarise(i=sum(logFC))%>%
  mutate(has_LA=ifelse(i>0,"LA+","LA-"))%>%group_by(has_LA)%>%
  slice_max(abs(i),n=5)%>%ungroup()%>%arrange(i)
pH<-res%>%filter(pathway%in%i$pathway&str_detect(ct,"En|Mes|Sm|^Ex",negate = T))%>%
  mutate(pathway=factor(pathway,levels=i$pathway))%>%
  ggplot(aes(y=pathway,x=logFC))+geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.1)+
    geom_jitter(aes(col=ct,size= adj.P.Val),height = .1,alpha=0.5)+
    theme_classic()+scale_color_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+
    scale_size(range=c(5,1),trans="sqrt",breaks = c(1e-10,1e-2,1))+
    guides(colour = "none")+geom_vline(xintercept = 0)
```
